_validation_note: No candidate cleared the gates in this run. Discovery ran across all four lanes over the 14-day window (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-09) and the broadened 21-day window (2026-09-18 onward). Every primary Texas agency host tried (www.puc.texas.gov, capitol.texas.gov, interchange.puc.texas.gov) was refused by the egress gateway with 403 policy denial or failed DNS, so no primary source body could be fetched. Search snippets were used only as discovery leads and are not evidence. Because primary_source_each_layer cannot be established for any candidate, no mechanism was selected. The 'fetched_at_utc' fields record the attempt time; fetch_status states the actual outcome. Gates not evaluated are recorded as false.
